tools.name: ghana_gov.how_to
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how to get, renew or replace a public document or registration in Ghana, what it costs, which documents to bring, or where to apply online (for example "how do I get a Ghana Card", "how much is a passport", "how do I renew my driver's licence" or "how do I register for NHI

tools.name: ghana_gov.check_website
tools.description: Use this when someone has a web address for a Ghana government service (a link in a message, a site that asks for payment, a "portal" for the Ghana Card, a licence, a passport, NHIS or a TIN) and asks whether it belongs to the agency. It says whether the address is one an agency on its list gives on

tools.name: ghana_gov.list_services
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which Ghana public services this tool can explain, or which agencies' web addresses it knows. It also names the services it looked for and could not read on the agency's own pages, with the reason. Do not use it for one named service: use ghana_gov.how_to.
